original_goal: 零基础掌握完整基础微积分
selected_goal: 在给定规则下，区分二次函数的平均与瞬时变化率，计算次数不超过2的多项式的导数值及简单区间定积分，并区分净有向面积与总面积。
background: 合成评测假设：已会分数、带符号四则运算、代入、展开平方和一次方程；尚未系统学过微积分。未做真人先修诊断。
authoring_method: Hand-authored fixed fixture; no claim of independent course-generation benchmark.

source_access.method: Supported web tool opened five official OpenStax sections; only identified rules/concepts used. No textbook fulltext or original image downloaded into repository.
